title: Eliminating payment friction: The fast track to trade
summary: Your business is moving faster than ever. You’ve streamlined your supply chain, digitised your operations, and expanded your reach to new markets. But when it comes to the financial infrastructure supporting that growth, many small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) find themselves working with banking processes designed for yesterday’s trade. With limited structure or resource bandwidth, bypassing the traditional banking walls can be a struggle. Today, modern, digital fintechs are creating new opportunities, especially in the emerging markets, for small and medium businesses to trade freely and scale their operations.
